---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea for this project
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Problem Statement
A clear and concise description of the problem. Ex. I'm always frustrated when [...]

## Proposed Solution
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## Alternative Solutions
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Benefits
Who benefits from this feature and how?
- [ ] End users (Telegram chat experience)
- [ ] Developers (code quality, maintainability)
- [ ] Project sustainability (performance, costs)

## Implementation Complexity
What's your assessment of implementation difficulty?
- [ ] Easy (few hours)
- [ ] Medium (1-2 days)
- [ ] Hard (multiple days, significant changes)
- [ ] Unknown

## Additional Context
Add any other context, mockups, or examples about the feature request here.

## Related Issues
Link any related issues or discussions here.
